val
aus val
for val
ani aus val

3 nosferatu, 3 ravnos, 2 tzimisce, 1 !ventrue, and
most intrestingly one tremere, who happens to have all the
disciplines valeren has as outferior (except obe). And is

Now then where does this leave me? Im still even more baffled

as a Saulot fan and owner of 6 adonai.

Sarcasm et al aren't easily conveyed. A fuller explanation of how I view
!Salubri and how it pertains to the Baali goes something like this. They, as a
whole, don't have disciplines, so any concern over their disciplines is
unimportant. So, besides being Sabbat, the only thing they have to offer is
the ability to play Blessing of the Name. BotN is okay. It's massively better
when you need to untap minions who don't untap or to get around infernal costs
and the like as it ceases being a close substitute to just untapping as normal.
Weakness of the BotN deck is that you never want to fail to play one in a
given turn once you start playing them. As !Salubri don't have disciplines,
they got jack for stealth. Baali cover this with Cloak. Then, neither Baali
nor the disciplineless !Salubri have bounce, so the two intercept from
BotN+Sense the Sin gives some sort of casual defense from being ousted. It's
all quite synergistic. Bad. But synergistic.

BTW, I was glancing through Lairs of the Hidden, supplement for V:TM involving
high powered vamps. There was an ability, Dream Combat?, that may have been
Valeren (either that or Obeah). I don't know if it's already in this game
under another name, if not, an opportunity to give Valeren something useful to
do.
